name: ABAT Plumbing and Heating LLC (ABAT Construction and Plumbing Inc.)
what_they_do: Plumbing, heating and bathroom-remodeling contractor on Davidson's Mill Road that has served Central New Jersey (Middlesex, Mercer, Somerset) for about 30 years, licensed, insured and bonded under NJ plumbing licence #13154, with 24/7 emergency, evening, weekend and holiday service and a warranty on all work.
customers: Homeowners in Middlesex, Mercer and Somerset counties needing plumbing repair, water-heater replacement or bathroom remodeling

size_signals.signal: 'As an independently owned business with over 30 years of experience' and NJ Plumbing License #: 13154
Four-page hibu-builder site (home, plumbing, water heaters, bathroom remodeling, contact) - typical one-to-three-van owner-operator footprint
Google listing has only 15 reviews, consistent with a small shop

website_review.primary_cta: 'Quit Monkeying Around -- Call ABAT!' with the number in a sticky header, plus 'Call for emergency service' and 'Contact us today'
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Simple contact form on /contact (Name, Email, Phone, Message) - a message drop, not a quote calculator or appointment booking
website_review.trust_signals: NJ plumbing licence number printed, insured/bonded, 30 years, warranty on all work, 'READ OUR REVIEWS' link, cookie/preferences controls
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Site is a stock hibu template with a monkey-themed slogan and generic stock images; copyright 2026 so not stale, but only four thin pages
website_review.search_basics: Title 'ABAT Construction and Plumbing Inc | Plumbing | North Brunswick NJ' with a description naming phone, licence, 30 years and services; individual pages exist for plumbing, water heaters and bathroom remodeling
top_issues: No hours on the home page (hours only appear on the contact page as 'Open 24/7') and no pricing guidance
JSON-LD is only a WebSite block - no LocalBusiness with address, hours or service area
Thin four-page template with no photos of actual work and no service-area pages

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google profile has the Plumber category, 'Open 24 hours', correct phone and address, but only 15 reviews and an 'Add photos & videos' prompt, so it is thin and possibly unclaimed. robots.txt is effectively open (only a sitemap line and 'User-agent: *'), so AI crawlers are allowed. Answerable: licence number, service area counties and 30-years claim are real text, but hours live only on the contact page (as 'Open 24/7'), no price ranges, and the only structured data is a WebSite block - no LocalBusiness, so an agent cannot confirm address/hours from markup. Bookable: a labelled 4-field contact form exists and no CAPTCHA, but there is no scheduling or quote flow - just a message that a human must answer.

operations_signals.signal: Advertises 24/7 plus evening, night, weekend and holiday service - phones must be answered round the clock by a very small team
Quote requests arrive as free-text 'Message' emails with no job-type or urgency fields, so every estimate requires a callback
Only 15 Google reviews after 30 years in business - review capture is clearly not systematic

top_opportunities.opportunity: Structured quote-request intake (job type, urgency, address, photos) with automatic acknowledgement and follow-up
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact form is a single free-text message box with no job fields; all estimates become callbacks

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add LocalBusiness schema, hours and service-area/price text across the four pages
top_opportunities.evidence: Only a WebSite JSON-LD block; hours appear just on the contact page; no price guidance anywhere

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated review requests after each completed job to lift 15 reviews toward local competitors
top_opportunities.evidence: 30 years in business but only 15 Google reviews versus 300+ for nearby rivals

scores.reasons: Site is functional but thin and phone-shaped; a small owner-operator with a licence and 30-year history can pay modestly; all three fixes are quick wins; everything was verified directly on site and Maps.
